Chart card with one tab for each indicator

Source: R/layout-tab_panels.R
cd_tabbed_charts_ui.Rd

A card that shows the same chart for several indicators, one tab each, with a "Custom" tab where the reader chooses any other indicator. The page says how one chart is drawn (uiInput and serverInput), and this module makes the tabs, switches between them and puts the chart tools of the tab on show in the card's header. Many analysis pages are built from it.

Usage

cd_tabbed_charts_ui(
  id,
  i18n,
  title_key,
  uiInput,
  indicators = NULL,
  customIndicators = get_analysis_indicators(),
  showCustom = TRUE,
  width = 12
)

cd_tabbed_charts_server(
  id,
  serverInput,
  indicators = NULL,
  customIndicators = get_analysis_indicators(),
  showCustom = TRUE,
  selected_tab = reactive(NULL),
  i18n = cd_i18n()
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label. In cd_tabbed_charts_server() it is the last argument and defaults to the translator the app registered with cd_use_i18n().

title_key

The translation key of the card's title.

uiInput

A function function(id, toolbar_inline) that returns the UI of one tab's chart (see Details).

indicators

A character vector of indicator codes, one tab each, in this order. NULL (the default) uses cd_default_indicator_set().

customIndicators

The indicators the Custom tab's chip offers, as cd_indicator_ui() takes them. Default get_analysis_indicators(). Only the ui uses it. The server accepts it and ignores it.

showCustom

Logical. TRUE (the default) adds the Custom tab after the indicators' tabs.

width

The card's width, passed to the kit's cd_chart_card(). Default 12. The kit's card takes a width and ignores it: a card is as wide as the place it is put in.

serverInput

A function function(id, indicator) that starts the server of one tab's chart (see Details).

selected_tab

A reactive that returns the key of a tab to show (an indicator's code or "custom"), or NULL. When its value changes to a key, the card switches to that tab. It lets another card's tabs drive this card's. Default reactive(NULL), which never switches.

Value

cd_tabbed_charts_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags (the card).

cd_tabbed_charts_server() returns a reactive holding the key of the tab on show: an indicator's code, or "custom".

Details

uiInput and serverInput are the two halves of one chart, usually cd_coverage_plot_ui() and a function that calls cd_coverage_plot_server():

  • uiInput(id, toolbar_inline = TRUE) is called once for each tab and returns that tab's chart. It must leave the chart's tools out when toolbar_inline is TRUE, because the card's header shows them. The header draws the tools with cd_coverage_plot_toolbar_ui(), so the chart must be a cd_coverage_plot_ui() or use the same ids.

  • serverInput(id, indicator) starts the chart of one tab. It is called once for each indicator, with the indicator's code as both arguments. For the Custom tab it is called once, with the id "custom" and a reactive that returns the indicator the reader chose; read either with cd_tab_indicator(). It runs inside this module, so id is used as it is, without ns().

A tab's label is the translation of opt_ followed by the indicator's code. The tabs that are not on show are hidden, and Shiny does not draw a hidden chart.

Give indicators and showCustom the same values in the ui and the server call.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a page's ui
cd_tabbed_charts_ui(ns("panel"), i18n, "title_coverage_national", cd_coverage_plot_ui,
  indicators = c("penta3", "measles1")
)

# in the page's server
cd_tabbed_charts_server("panel",
  serverInput = function(id, indicator) {
    cd_coverage_plot_server(
      id = id,
      filename = reactive(paste0(indicator, "_coverage")),
      data_fn = reactive(my_coverage_data(cache(), indicator)),
      sheet_name = reactive(i18n$t(paste0("opt_", indicator))),
      i18n = i18n
    )
  },
  indicators = c("penta3", "measles1")
)
} # }
